Primarily serves pharmaceutical R&D, biotech, and academic research teams. Key technology: APEX (ultra-fast virtual screening engine) for screening billions of compounds in seconds.

products.notes: Targets 600+ disease targets in partnership with 250+ organizations. Infrastructure: WEKA data platform, NVIDIA GPU compute, AWS cloud. Not a regulated clinical system.
